newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 14.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Delegation from China's Jiangzhou province to launch a joint venture company to grow rice around Ivory Coast's capital Yamoussoukro

- New book by Ivorian economics professor N'guessan Tchetche says low three percent interest rate offered by the West Africa CFA franc zone Central Bank, the BCEAO, encourages capital flight from the region
- Ivorian government sells off two hotels -- Palm Club in Abidjan and Mont Korhogo in the northern town of Korhogo -- as part of privatisation exercise; both bought by Ivorian companies
- Ivorian national assembly discusses book on tax procedures designed to smoothe relations between tax officials and those being taxed

- Privatisation committee says that sale of shares in Ivorian packaging company SIEM, a subsidiary of CarnaudMetalBox, has been extended to March 28; shares to be quoted on Abidjan stock exchange on second-tier market
